Anika: Heads-up: large customer wants Nimbus-XL onboarded to Hosted with pin support + SLA, target GA ~6 weeks. Can we do it?
Ravi: 6 weeks = aggressive. Need microbench (latency p50/p95/p99), memory, token cost. Also test KV-cache for chats.
Maya: Customer requirement: p99 <200ms for short prompts. That's the hard constraint.
Jo: Hosted vs Dedicated affects approach. They plan Hosted first then Dedicated if we support pin+region isolation.
Sam: Plan: sample 5k prompts from their corpus, run quant profiles 0.25/0.5/1.0. Microbench in 4d, full slice in 10d.
Ravi: Verify streaming + function-call compatibility—some quant modes mutate tokens.
Anika: They also want a soft-deprecation guarantee: 6 months notice + migration runbook. Is that feasible?
Ravi: Yes if we provide a compatibility shim (auto-fallback to previous major during migration). Engineering ~2 sprints to add rollout policy + fallback.
Maya: UX: expose "pin to version" checkbox in Console and API param `pin_version=true`. Devex needs spec.
Jo: Resource ask: eng-runtime needs 1 engineer for 3 sprints for rollout+fallback. PMs need to prioritize.
Ravi: Risk: delays other onboardings (~2-3w). Ops load rises during canary; add autoscale curve plan.
Sam: Call out pricing delta if they opt for Dedicated pinned capacity. Sales needs a pricing proposal.
Maya: Audit requirement: pin actions audit log + who changed pins. Security ok with Console logs + export for Hosted. KMS work only for Private.
Anika: Proposed launch gates: (1) p99 <=220ms on Hosted with recommended quant; (2) no regressions in streaming/function-calls; (3) rollout + pin support implemented; (4) Legal/Sec signoff.
Ravi: Canary policy: start <=1% traffic, realtime fallback to pinned model if SLO breached. Ops to monitor noisy neighbor effects.
Maya: Deprecation policy: minimum 6-month window, webhook notify + autogenerated migration notes highlighting prompt diffs.
Sam: I'll publish bench artifacts to the model card (perf matrix, quant recommendation, sample prompts, migration notes).
Jo: Timeline suggestion: Day0 bench; Day4 microbench; Day10 full bench; Day12 devex/API spec; Day18 feature landed; Day25 canary; Day42 GA.
Anika: Action items: Sam->bench (4d); Ravi->eng estimate & PRD (EOW); Maya->API/Console mockups (3d); Anika->customer comms & legal (2d).
